sign_in: OAuth (Sign in with Sorted) for ChatGPT and Claude; a personal Sorted key held in the SORTED_TOKEN environment variable for the Codex plugin
switched_on: Only when Sorted has switched feeds on for the company; otherwise these four tools are not in the tool list

tools.name: define_feed
tools.rule: First call with name and numbers (or table): returns a preview and a confirm_token, saves nothing. After the owner's yes, call again with only confirm_token.

limits.labels_unique: each label (and each table row name) once, ignoring capitals; row names follow the label length limit
limits.sent_label_match: a sent label must equal the declared label exactly, capitals included
limits.currency_only_for_money: only the money unit takes a currency; any other unit with a currency is refused
limits.money_needs_currency: a three-letter code from the currencies list
limits.values_must_be: JSON numbers, never text such as "12.40"
limits.as_of: a date (2026-10-05) or a date and time; at most 10 minutes in the future, at most 45 days old, newer than the feed's last send
limits.same_as_of_same_numbers: accepted again, stores nothing (safe to retry)
